title: antidesma paxii
intro: Antidesma paxii, commonly known as the Malaysian milkberry or simply milkberry, is a species of plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, cough, and digestive issues, as well as its use as a natural remedy for wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Antidesma paxii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Antidesma paxii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
